title: [WT-10] Wrappers: quality gate on the merged tree under the land lease
description:
Plan against docs/plans/2026-10-30-per-task-worktrees.md §2.2 (L3, L6, L14) and §2.3.

Objective: when settings.qualityGate applies, main is updated only after the gate passes on the exact merged tree that will land (epic rail 1). Seats of this project serialize through one daemon lease, so the gate rarely re-runs under contention.

Deliverable, in scripts/moe-agent.sh and scripts/moe-agent.ps1 as twins:
- L3, only when a gate will run: acquire_resource on `git-land-<target>` (every character outside [A-Za-z0-9._-] replaced by '-', at most 64 chars), then wait_for_resource until granted, bounded by MOE_LAND_LEASE_WAIT_SEC (default 1800). A timeout or RPC failure gives MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_LAND_LEASE and lands nothing (record failed; WT-11 adds the route with reason contention).
- L6: the existing freeze_candidate B M + run_frozen_gate (New-MoeFrozenCandidate / Invoke-MoeFrozenGate), fed the merged tree M with parent B. Failure gives the existing MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_GATE and lands nothing (WT-11 adds the route with reason gate).
- Under the lease at most 2 L4-L10 attempts, each re-running the gate on the new merge.
- L14: release_resource on every path, including failures and the exit trap.
- Cases in scripts/tests/postflight.sh and postflight.ps1. Depends on WT-09 (task-0921d6d76a6b40a685077245b19ac639).

NOT in scope: declaring the resource in settings (the §7.3 runbook); the unlanded route (WT-11); shared-mode gate behaviour, which stays unchanged; docs (WT-17/WT-18).

Verification: node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs bash && bash scripts/tests/worktree-landing.sh && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh (and on a Windows seat: node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs powershell)
definitionOfDone: postflight case (both harnesses): with a qualityGate, the gate's frozen commit has tree M (the merge of B and T) and parent B; a passing gate lands C, a failing gate prints MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_GATE and leaves main unchanged.
postflight case: the fake proxy sees acquire_resource for git-land-main before the gate and release_resource after, on both the pass and the fail path; with no qualityGate no lease call is made.
postflight case: a lease wait past MOE_LAND_LEASE_WAIT_SEC prints MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_LAND_LEASE and lands nothing.
bash scripts/tests/worktree-landing.sh still passes unchanged; existing shared-mode gate cases pass unchanged.
Both wrappers carry the same MOE_WORKTREE_/MOE_LAND_/MOE_CONTROL_/MOE_BOARD_ codes; the verification command exits 0 and postflight.ps1 passes on a Windows seat.

implementationPlan.description: 1. Bind the landed producer interfaces and add deterministic lease fixtures. Re-read WT-S comments, WT-09 landing rounds, WT-10G and WT-10P source/hand-offs after their structural dependencies are satisfied; do not write a second landing engine or emulate missing prerequisites. G's declared contract is `run_frozen_gate worktree` / `Invoke-MoeFrozenGate ... -WorktreeMode`; P's new wrapper-only contract is absolute Unix-ms MOE_PROXY_ONESHOT_DEADLINE_MS bounding the entire one-shot proxy call, including connect/EOF. Confirm the selected built proxy contains that fix before testing a queued wait. Preserve shared-mode default call signatures. In the existing fake proxy, add narrowly opt-in worktree lease scenarios and log acquire_resource/wait_for_resource/release_resource in order together with existing candidate/check/ledger events. Model granted with lease identity, queued then granted, repeated timedOut, daemon refusal/malformed response, withheld reply until proxy deadline, and release failure once then success. Validate caller taskId/workerId and exact resource id; default fixture modes must not change. No test may pretend granted:false is success. Use persisted fixture counters per temp project, not process-local counters (every RPC gets a fresh process).

2. Implement L3 acquire/wait in both worktree completion arms, with tests first (DoD 2–3). Separate raw configured qualityGate from the scope-filtered command. A configured gate means take the lease even on a mid-epic/scope-skipped completion; absent/blank gate means no lease RPC. Checkpoints/shared mode make no new lease calls. Introduce acquire_land_lease / Acquire-MoeLandLease (new helpers) and per-landing resource/attempted/granted/lease-generation state. Resource identity is the complete `git-land-` + target string with every character outside ASCII [A-Za-z0-9._-] replaced by '-', then truncated to 64 total characters; test slash, Unicode and long targets. Parse MOE_LAND_LEASE_WAIT_SEC as a positive bounded numeric duration, default 1800 when unset; invalid/zero/negative/overflow input fails closed with MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_LAND_LEASE before a resource RPC. Establish one overall deadline before acquire. Supply the actual landing task and worker, never create a synthetic task or use report_blocked during finalization. Call acquire_resource; only literal granted:true admits L4. For granted:false, call wait_for_resource repeatedly with timeoutMs=min(600000, remaining budget), never request below its 1000ms minimum (expire instead). Continue only a genuine timedOut response while budget remains; cancelled/error/malformed/RPC failure fails closed. Set P's one-shot deadline env to the same overall deadline for each call and restore it afterward (PS try/finally, Bash per-call env), so a hung/not-connected proxy cannot exceed the configured bound. A grant returned after the deadline is not admission: release it and fail. Example invariant:
```text
if !configuredGate: return admitted_without_lease
attempted = true
reply = acquire(resource, realTask, realWorker, absoluteDeadline)
while reply.granted !== true and reply is queued/timedOut and remaining >= 1000ms:
    reply = wait(resource, realTask, realWorker, min(600000, remaining), absoluteDeadline)
if reply.granted !== true or deadline_expired: LAND_CODE=MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_LAND_LEASE; fail
```
Both postflight harnesses must show acquire before any gate/publication, queued grant after a delay greater than the old two-second proxy cutoff, scope-skipped gate still acquires, no configured gate makes no lease call, timeout/non-answer/refusal prints the code with main unchanged and no candidate/gate/push, and no successful completion row is recorded. Use short test budgets and fake replies, not a real 30-minute wait.

3. Implement L14 cleanup and failure-safe resource ownership (DoD 2–3). Introduce idempotent release_land_lease / Release-MoeLandLease and invoke it after every worktree completion return path plus cleanup_temp/PowerShell outer finally, before deregistration and before clearing the landing identity. Mark acquisition attempted before sending the RPC so an ambiguous reply still cancels this task's queue/lease. Release only this resource + original task + worker, never force and never another task; when the granted lease's acquiredAt is known, use the existing release preconditions to avoid releasing a later lease generation. Queue-only cleanup uses the existing task-scoped release behavior. Give cleanup its own short bounded proxy deadline (5 seconds), restoring the environment afterward. Clear ownership state only after an acknowledged release; a failed release warns MOE_LAND_LEASE_RELEASE_FAILED and remains eligible for one exit-trap retry. Cleanup failure must not overwrite a known published/failed landing outcome or rerun a publication; daemon lease expiry/releaseOnDeregister remains a backstop, not a successful-release claim. Preserve existing signal deferral across publication/recording from WT-08/09; a handled exit before publication releases and preserves T. Mirrored tests assert release after passing and failing gate, after lease timeout/ambiguous acquire, after merge/publication failure, and on a handled exit while queued/gating; never publish on a missing grant. Test release failure then cleanup retry without a duplicate committed ledger row. SIGKILL cannot run a trap: do not claim otherwise.

4. Insert L6 on each fresh merged candidate and enforce round budgets (DoD 1,4). Consume WT-09's existing round after L5/L5b and before L7/L8/L9. Keep T fixed, derive fresh B/M each round, and call `freeze_candidate "$B" "$M"` then `run_frozen_gate worktree`; PS uses `New-MoeFrozenCandidate $Git $M $B`, existing Send-MoeCandidate, then `Invoke-MoeFrozenGate $Git $Frozen $command -WorktreeMode`. Candidate/check and journal must name this exact M and parent B, never pre-merge task T or control HEAD. Preserve evidence-refusal error handling: freeze/evidence/gate/sparse/integrity failure is MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_GATE, retains the existing failed+rescue path, releases, and never publishes. WT-11 later adds outcome unlanded/reason gate/contention; do not implement it here. If the effective gate runs, allow at most TWO L4-L9 rounds under one lease and rerun the gate for the new merged pair on every retry, with no stale result reuse. If scope skips the gate, preserve THREE ungated rounds but still lease when a gate is configured; if none is configured preserve the existing no-lease three-round behavior. Keep remote unknown-outcome/journal and non-forced push rules unchanged. Do not let MOE_DISABLE_QUALITY_GATE bypass an applicable worktree-mode configured gate: refuse safely before publication; shared-mode opt-out is unchanged. Twin tests use non-overlapping peer/task hunks to prove frozen HEAD^{tree}=M and HEAD^=B, published C^{tree}=M and C^=B; a gate reads both hunks and no .moe. A failing gate and a gate creating .moe/x leave main unchanged and release; the latter includes MOE_WORKTREE_GATE_INTEGRITY. Force one target race: second gate sees new B/M, then succeeds; force two losses: contention failure with exactly two gate runs and no task publication. Existing shared gate and WT-08T tests remain unchanged.

5. Single final verification gate. From root run exactly `node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs bash && bash scripts/tests/worktree-landing.sh && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh`. Require safe-harness failureClass NONE, held-out landing cases green, parity PASS and exit 0. On a native Windows seat additionally run `node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs powershell` against the same revision (PS5.1, not a skipped or substituted Linux pwsh result). Compare the sorted grep -oE `MOE_(WORKTREE|LAND|CONTROL|BOARD|MIGRATION)_[A-Z0-9_]+` sets of the two wrappers; sets must match, including introduced lease/integrity codes. Permanent parity-script expansion stays with WT-19. Verify held-out scripts against their WT-08T landed version with a read-only diff; never edit them to make this gate pass. Load regression-check/verification-before-completion. Capture fresh command, exitCode and safe outputTail for complete_task, plus native Windows evidence. Keep raw postflight fixture output out of chat/artifacts; postflight-safe exists for that reason. If dependencies' files or native Windows evidence are unavailable, report that honestly rather than fabricate green.

6. Final adversarial self-review, once, task-scoped. Load adversarial-self-review and inspect literal grant checks, a lease granted just as the deadline expires, lost acquire/release replies, a waiter becoming holder before cleanup, signal/exception before and after publication, release retries, and scoped-but-configured gates. Confirm a no-answer proxy cannot wait past the caller deadline, no global env leaks, no other task's lease is released, and no cleanup rewrites a confirmed remote publication as failure. Check exactly M/B are frozen/gated/journaled/published, two gated versus three ungated rounds, re-gating after contention, .moe never materialized by the selected gate runner, no shared-mode changes and no held-out test weakening. Preserve BOM/line endings and owned-only atomic Bash saves; don't stage peer dirt. Keep source/test diff <=400 net LOC through prerequisite reuse, not by omitting cases. Refresh the same verification gate after any fix, complete through Moe with accurate modifiedFiles and fresh evidence; wrappers own Git writes. Documentation/resource declaration and migration flags remain their named later tasks.

comments.author: worker-0062feec
comments.content:
Contract correction from the WT-S revision after QA reject 1. Where this comment and the row's description differ, the revised docs/plans/2026-10-30-per-task-worktrees.md and this comment win. Plan against revised §2.2 (L3/L6/L14), §2.3 and §7.3.

1. Take the lease on EVERY completion landing, not "only when a gate will run".
   - Acquire, wait, release and the bounds are unchanged.
   - Rounds are L4-L9: at most 3 without a gate, 2 with one.

2. Gate worktree arm (rail 3):
   - Add the gate worktree with `--no-checkout`. Never pass `core.sparseCheckout=false`.
   - Then run `sparse-checkout set --no-cone '/*' '!/.moe/'` and `read-tree -mu HEAD`.
   - The integrity helper is gate_integrity_wt / Test-MoeGateIntegrityWorktree:
     - keep the HEAD and write-tree checks;
     - clear assume-unchanged and skip-worktree bits only outside `.moe/`;
     - require a clean diff-files;
     - fail with MOE_WORKTREE_GATE_INTEGRITY when `<gate>/.moe` exists, before or after the command. That makes the landing unlanded `gate`.
   - Shared mode keeps today's run_frozen_gate / gate_integrity unchanged (rail 4).
   - Cases:
     - a gate command that creates `.moe/x` → integrity failure, nothing published;
     - `.moe` is absent while the command runs;
     - the shared-mode gate behaves as before.

3. Migration landing `--land-branch <branch>` / `-LandBranch <branch>` (§7.3):
   - Sequence: L3, then rounds of:
     - L4;
     - L5 `merge-tree --write-tree B <branch>`;
     - L6 on exactly M;
     - L7 C = `commit-tree M -p B -p <branch tip>`;
     - L9 and L10.
     Then L14.
   - L6 always runs settings.qualityGate, whatever qualityGateScope says. With no gate set, refuse with MOE_MIGRATION_NO_GATE before any fetch.
   - Skip L0-L2, L5b, L8 and L11-L13. Record no Candidate, CheckRun or ledger row.
   - These publish nothing: a conflict, a failed gate, a lease timeout, 2 exhausted rounds.
   - An unknown outcome stops. Once main contains the branch, a re-run exits 0 with MOE_COMMIT_NOTHING_TO_COMMIT.
   - Cases: clean landing, conflict, no-gate refusal, re-run idempotence.

If this exceeds taskSizing at plan time, split item 3 into its own row (SPIDR, Interface) and make WT-16 depend on it.

comments.author: worker-0062feec
comments.content:
Follow-up to the WT-S revision comment above. It narrows that comment's item 1 so it matches this row's DoD2 (definitionOfDone is human-owned). Revised §2.2 L3 and §2.3 now say the same:
- While `settings.qualityGate` is set, take the land lease on every completion landing, whether or not this landing's `qualityGateScope` runs the gate. This stops an ungated peer from publishing while a gated landing is gating.
- With no `qualityGate` set, make no lease call, exactly as DoD2 says.
- Safety never depends on the lease. The local CAS or the non-forced push decides, and WT-08T's race case runs with no gate.
Add a case: when the qualityGate is scoped so this landing does not run it, the landing still takes the lease and releases it.
Also extend your parity grep to cover `MOE_MIGRATION_`.

comments.author: architect-899a90d6
comments.content:
The proxy contract from WT-10P (task-b5a176355a7c443d98952466b409f941, plan rev 1, now WORKING). Build against these exact semantics; read the landed proxy bytes before relying on the text.

1. `MOE_PROXY_ONESHOT_DEADLINE_MS` is an absolute Unix epoch in ms, plain decimal digits forming a safe integer.
   - Unset or blank means no bound, so a PS restore can blank it.
   - Any other invalid value fails closed: one JSON-RPC error with id null, 'Invalid MOE_PROXY_ONESHOT_DEADLINE_MS: <reason>', then exit 1 without connecting.
2. When the deadline expires (during connect, queued, sent or the EOF drain):
   - One error per known pending id: 'Proxy deadline exceeded (MOE_PROXY_ONESHOT_DEADLINE_MS)'. A null-id error is written when no id is known yet (the proxy never connected).
   - Then exit 1, with no late success and no reconnect.
3. The long EOF drain applies only to a session that never sent MCP `initialize`. moe_rpc and Invoke-MoeRpc must keep piping one bare tools/call.
   - A pending wait_for_resource then drains until its daemon reply or sentAt + MOE_BLOCKING_TIMEOUT_MS (default 660000).
   - Keep timeoutMs at 600000 or less, so the daemon's own timedOut reply wins.
4. A daemon socket lost mid-drain errors at once with 'Connection to daemon lost before response received'.
   - That path, and the 2s grace paths, still exit 0 with an error line, exactly as today. Decide on the reply's result or error, never on the exit code alone.
   - SIGINT/SIGTERM cap any drain at 2s.

comments.author: worker-0062feec
comments.content:
Spike self-review correction (docs/plans/2026-10-30-per-task-worktrees.md §2.2 L3/L6, §7.3 migration landing; section numbers unchanged). Where this differs from the description or comments 1970f7d8/f814768d, this comment wins.

1. Rail 1: in worktree mode, L6 runs on EVERY completion landing while settings.qualityGate is set, and qualityGateScope is ignored. Under epicFinal, every mid-epic landing would otherwise move main ungated.
   - The `qualityGate deferred` scope check gets a worktree-mode exception: in sh it is in the post-flight main loop, in ps1 in Invoke-MoeLanding.
   - Shared mode keeps that check (rail 4).
   - Add a case: a worktree landing of a mid-epic task with scope epicFinal runs the gate.
2. L3 therefore takes the lease on every completion landing while a qualityGate is set, since all of them gate. With no qualityGate, no lease call is made, exactly as your DoD item 2 says.
3. --land-branch / -LandBranch:
   - It takes NO lease: acquire_resource needs a task the caller owns, and the drain leaves no lander to wait for.
   - It runs L6 in the .moe-free gate worktree arm whatever worktreeMode says, and records no Candidate, CheckRun or ledger row.
   - It builds C = commit-tree M -p B -p <branch tip> with no commit hooks: the hooked-commit helper refuses a second parent, and the gate on M stands in for the hooks.
   - It skips L0-L3, L5b, L8 and L11-L14.
   - Drop MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_LAND_LEASE from its failure list.

# WT-10 task-bound lease and merged-tree gate
Goal: gate exactly the merged candidate that may publish, while serializing this daemon's configured-gate landers and releasing the lease on all exits. Architecture: extend the prerequisite WT-09 worktree completion round; use daemon resource APIs for L3/L14 and the existing frozen candidate/evidence flow for L6. Shared checkout behavior stays byte-for-byte equivalent. Tech: Bash/Python, Windows PowerShell 5.1, Node proxy, Git plumbing.
SPIDR Interface splits are explicit structural prerequisites: WT-10G task-19cbba2272ee4a1c9f0a9c933f339f59 produces the optional sparse gate runner; WT-10P task-b5a176355a7c443d98952466b409f941 fixes one-shot EOF drain and produces MOE_PROXY_ONESHOT_DEADLINE_MS. Migration comment item 3 moved to WT-10M task-253884005a59471fb7c59ef38e1f3cc1, on which WT-16 now depends. This parent retains all five original DoD items. WT-19 remains the only full-epic hardening task and covers new slices transitively.

Bash QUALITY_GATE is cleared when scope defers it, so preserve a separate configured-gate flag before that clearing. Current gate runner materializes .moe and current proxy EOF ends waits at 2s: do not reuse either unchanged in worktree mode; producers G/P fix them. wait_for_resource timeoutMs clamps to 1000..600000 and replies granted or timedOut; resource APIs require real task/worker identity. release_resource can remove both owned lease and queue.
